kernel.governing_law: What was once given by the body's own season (youth, hair, flowers, feeling) is lost to time, commerce, and growth — and the speaker, remembering, holds the vanished state as the real one.
kernel.mutated_relation: The conditions that had to hold for each utterance to be speakable — the transmission-Loss that makes the telling necessary, the prior state whose absence generates the speech — become the primary surface: what speaks is not the memory but the machinery of its becoming-memory.
kernel.beats:
when she was young -> before the telling had a reason
my mother said -> the voice that will not sound again relayed
girls -> the ones not yet singular
used to bind -> performed the act whose loss makes it describable
dark locks -> what the body shed without deciding
purple bands -> a dye whose source had not yet become a price
weave -> the verb that requires two free hands and no buyer
fresh flowers -> what dies the same day and therefore was never kept
braids of summer yellow -> the color that exists only in the light that has moved on
a simple ornament -> the thing no one called ornament until the other kind arrived
now -> the word that splits every sentence it enters
gaudy things -> what can be described because it was purchased, not grown
bought from Sardis -> the distance that made the object survive the body
when winter cold -> at the threshold where the organ learns it is an organ
sneaks -> the arrival that precedes its own detection
over the heart -> over the heart (RETAIN: the verdict requires the site where the condition registers to remain literal — the machinery needs the organ named)
wing beats slow -> the measure drops below the rate of its own counting
then stillness -> then stillness (RETAIN: the condition for this utterance is the same stillness — the silence that makes the line speakable is the silence it names)
long ago I loved you -> the sentence that cannot be uttered in its own tense
Atthis -> Atthis (RETAIN: the name is the residue that proves the condition — without it, no loss is particular)
tiny girl -> the scale that only exists inside the later body's looking back
seemed so -> the verb of appearance that confesses the perceiver has changed, not the perceived
small and awkward -> the qualities visible only from the size that replaced them

artifacts.enantiomorph:
*Sappho 98a*

Before the telling had a reason,
the voice that will not sound again relayed,
the ones not yet singular performed the act whose loss makes it describable
with a dye whose source had not yet become a price,

or the verb that requires two free hands and no buyer
what dies the same day and therefore was never kept
through the color that exists only in the light that has moved on,
and that was the thing no one called ornament until the other kind arrived.

The word that splits every sentence it enters what can be described because it was purchased, not grown
the distance that made the object survive the body.

*Sappho 42*

at the threshold where the organ learns it is an organ
    the arrival that precedes its own detection
over the heart, the measure drops below the rate of its own counting
    then stillness

*Sappho 49*

the sentence that cannot be uttered in its own tense, Atthis,
when you were the scale that only exists inside the later body's looking back,
and the verb of appearance that confesses the perceiver has changed, not the perceived
the qualities visible only from the size that replaced them.

independent.recovered_law: Each concrete image or narrative element in Text A is replaced in Text B by a self-referential meta-description of the linguistic or conceptual operation that the original image performs — turning objects into definitions of their own function within the poem's structure.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe a shift from concrete content to meta-structural self-description, but the declared claim specifically emphasizes the conditions/machinery of memory-transmission becoming the surface, while the recovered claim more broadly describes images replaced by self-referential descriptions of their own function — overlapping but differently scoped structural transformations.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion (Sappho 49) continues the meta-descriptive, self-referential replacement pattern consistently through to the end.
